text:
alex.taylor: Hi all — first day here. Just unboxed my MacBook Pro (M1) and trying to enroll in MDM during setup but getting 'Profile install failed (403)'. FileVault never turned on. Asset tag RWI-0472. Who should I ping?
it-support: Welcome and congrats! :tada: Can you run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and `sudo fdesetup status` in Terminal and paste output? Also confirm serial/asset tag (got RWI-0472).
alex.taylor: `profiles: No enrolled profile found` and `FileVault is Off`. I also noticed a banner in System Settings: "System extension from 'Redwood MDM' was blocked".
it-support: Thanks. Two quick paths: 1) our MDM server returned 403 (failed push) or 2) macOS blocked the kernel/system extension during first-boot. I'm going to reissue a re-enroll token for RWI-0472 now. After that try `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and reboot. If you see a Security & Privacy "Allow" button after reboot, click it then finish enrollment.
lina-ops: Re-enroll token pushed for asset RWI-0472. You should get a notification to accept corporate enrollment and complete Okta SSO.
alex.taylor: Got a "Corporate device enrollment requested" notification. Clicked Accept, got redirected to Okta and completed SSO.
it-support: Check `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` again.
alex.taylor: Now says `profiles: Enrolled via MDM (mdm.redwood.internal)` — looks good.
it-support: Nice. I also triggered the FileVault policy. You should see a modal asking to enable FileVault and choose recovery escrow. Opt for KMS escrow if you're okay with us storing the recovery key.
alex.taylor: Followed prompts and agreed to escrow to KMS. `sudo fdesetup status` now: `FileVault is On`.
sam: adding to inventory: serial C02X7YYYYY, asset RWI-0472, dev package and Homebrew/VSCode allowed in whitelist.
alex.taylor: Can now install Homebrew and VS Code, everything looks normal. Huge thanks for the fast help :sparkles:
mdm-bot: Notice: Profile install completed for asset RWI-0472 at 2026-04-02T09:12:05Z.
alex.taylor: closing thread — appreciate the help!
